IgriHuman-idle: a person stands still, shifts their weight and looks around
IgriHuman-walk: a person walks forward at a relaxed pace, swinging their arms
IgriHuman-panic: a person runs away in panic with both arms raised above their head, looking back over their shoulder
IgriHuman-aim: a person stands with the right arm stretched forward holding a fire extinguisher, bracing it with the left hand, and sprays
IgriRabbit-idle: a rabbit sits still, sniffs the air and twitches its ears
IgriRabbit-run: a rabbit runs away at full speed in quick bounds
IgriSquirrel-idle: a squirrel stands still, looks around and flicks its tail
IgriDeer-idle: a deer lowers its head to graze, then raises it and looks around
IgriDeer-gallop: a deer gallops forward at full speed with its tail raised
IgriBird-idle: a small bird pecks at the ground and looks around
IgriBird-fly: a small bird flaps its wings and flies forward
